name: @mandusec/cdp-relay
description: Mandu's browser chokepoint (wrapper layer): a relay on the DevTools (CDP) connection between a browser agent and Chrome. What Chrome sends the agent (DOM, accessibility tree, script results, network bodies) passes the arbiter's prompt filter as harness text, so a registered secret reaches the agent, and through it its model, only as its $MDU:* placeholder; a placeholder the agent types is put back only into a page whose origin the egress decision allows, checked and inserted in one turn of the page. Pixel commands are refused (text first). Fail-closed. All decisions go through the arbiter over IPC; this package never opens the symbol DB.
